messages:
emma-sec: Heads-up — SAST alert after the RBAC refactor on staging. Detector flagged 'wide-perm' on service-account-role.

sam-eng: saw that. repro steps?

emma-sec: steps: deploy branch rb-2026, run integration tests, sample failure stack in pipeline. Error: 'var hasPrivilegeEscalation=true' (see CI log)

ci-bot: [CI] job: security/sast reported 3 findings. link: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/1934567890/sast

olivia-qa: attached excerpt: ```json
{ "file": "pkg/auth/rbac.go", "line": 238, "finding": "uses wildcard verbs" }
```

raj-ops: is this a regression from K8s role binding defaults? We changed cluster-admin->team-admin mapping last week.

sam-eng: yes the role we created has `verbs: ["*"]` to simplify rollout. My bad — temporary.

emma-sec: Need a playbook: triage -> determine FP vs real -> mitigate -> prevent. Quick ask: can we enable audit logs for that SA and enable KMS encryption? current logs go to s3-unencrypted.

miguel-ps: KMS integration for audit logs is in private-deploy-runbook. KMS key UUID: `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyR-01` — but on hosted cluster we use cloud-managed key. Need IAM perms: kms.cryptoEncrypt on key.

raj-ops: action: raj will enable write-audit logs to encrypted bucket, sam will patch role to narrow verbs, emma will mark finding as active until validated. timeline: 90m?

sam-eng: patch I'll apply: ```yaml
kind: Role
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch"]
```

olivia-qa: after patch I'll run the integration suite and re-run SAST scan. If FP, mark as suppressed with reason: 'temporary wildcard used for rollout, narrowed in commit' and reference PR.

emma-sec: suppression must include JIRA and audit trail. Create ticket SEC-4582 and link PR.

sam-eng: created PR 7458, linked to SEC-4582.

ci-bot: [CI] re-run SAST: 1 remaining finding (audit-logging misconfig)

miguel-ps: for audit logging misconfig, the fix is to add bucket lifecycle and encryption. Example command to verify encryption: `aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket redwood-audit-staging` should show SSE-KMS.

raj-ops: I'll run the command and grant kms:Encrypt to the cluster's service account.

emma-sec: also add immutable audit logs retention policy and point to console: https://console.redwood/ops/audit-config

sam-eng: after changes, can we add a gating check in premerge CI: `check-audit-config`? If missing, block.

emma-sec: yes create a small CI job that runs `scripts/check_audit.sh` and fails if unencrypted.

olivia-qa: note: don't suppress the finding until logs are verified. Also add test that uploads a sample event and verifies decrypt with KMS.

sam-eng: on it, will submit patch tonight and notify oncall.

emma-sec: oncall @raj-ops please ack and help with KMS perms.

raj-ops: ack. will escalate to infra for key policy change if needed.

miguel-ps: copying runbook: https://confluence.redwood/secure-sdlc/audit-kms-runbook

emma-sec: thanks. I'll update the triage doc with steps and close SEC-4582 when verification passes.

olivia-qa: FYI: if we see similar wildcards in other roles, we should add a lint rule: `no-wildcard-verbs` in our rbac linter.

sam-eng: good idea. will add rule in next sprint.

ci-bot: [Ticket] SEC-4582 updated: status=in-progress, assignees=[emma-sec,sam-eng,raj-ops]

emma-sec: closing action items summary: 1) narrow role (sam) 2) enable SSE-KMS on audit bucket (raj) 3) CI check and tests (sam+olivia) 4) update triage doc and suppression policy (emma). target: EOD today.

sam-eng: done on role patch, PR link https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/7458

raj-ops: enabled SSE-KMS, verified with `aws s3api get-bucket-encryption`. log retention set to 365 days.

olivia-qa: re-run SAST and integration -> all green. re-open if anything pops.

ci-bot: [CI] SAST cleared for PR 7458.

emma-sec: thanks team. I'll run final verification and close SEC-4582.
